This policy describes Dopa's current product behavior. It does not apply to third-party services you choose to connect except where Dopa receives information from them.

Structured competitor evidence is normally retained for 90 days; minimal research input snapshots and provider request metadata are normally removed after 30 days.
Uploaded media and generated model assets may be retained temporarily by the scoring service to complete and deliver an analysis.
Some records may remain in backups or fraud-prevention logs for a limited period after deletion.
